image_description: A taxidermied weasel (likely a stoat or ermine in winter coat) posed standing upright on its hind legs against a plain grey background. The animal has white fur with dark tips on the tail and ears. It is positioned next to a large, irregular piece of driftwood or bark which appears to be part of the display mount. The weasel's front paws are raised, and its posture is stiff, characteristic of a museum specimen.

The ears are short, rounded, and positioned low on the head, consistent with the species.
